intro: The Baseline Double Action Ankle Joints are designed to offer a slim line and sleek low profile component while still providing a strong and durable part. These joints are fully machined offering a high quality and cost-effective component. The line is offered in Stainless Steel and Aluminum with squared off channel for easy install of uprights. The Baseline Ankle Joints are offered with a standard head design for rivets, or a modular head design with tapped attachment holes for screws. The upright channel can accept 3/16” x 5’8” or 1/4” x 5/8” bar stock. This versatile joint allows for plantar and dorsi flexion fine tuning with spring assist/resist. Anterior/Posterior channels come standard with springs, but pins can be requested to lock out completely or to block dorsi or plantar motion. The joints can be purchased as joint head only or with aluminum or stainless uprights attached. Baseline Ankle Joints are proudly made in the USA!

name: Vertex Dynamic Ratchet Lock Ankle Joint - Adult
group: Vertex Dynamic Ratchet Lock Action Ankle Joint

variations.name: Vertex Dynamic Ratchet Lock Ankle Joint - Adult

short: The Vertex Dynamic Ratchet Lock Ankle Joint incorporatesa unique one way pressure activated ratcheting locking mechanism. This mechanism allows the patient to easily don the orthosis whilepositioned in plantar flexion. Once activator strap is fastened theankle joint will lock into any desired dorsi-flexion position, while not allowing the patient to go back into plantar flexion. The joint willallow for more dorsi-flexion, but will not allow additional plantar flexion. This ankle joint allows dynamic management of plantar flexion contractures in weight bearing and non-weight bearing devices. It also allows progressive management of plantar flexion contractures throughout the therapy rehab process. Accommodating progressive dorsi-flexion position as patient’s range increases. Once lock is released the joint will function as a free motion ankle joint.

This mechanism allows the patient to easily don the orthosis whilepositioned in plantar flexion. Once activator strap is fastened theankle joint will lock into any desired dorsi-flexion position, while not allowing the patient to go back into plantar flexion. The joint willallow for more dorsi-flexion, but will not allow additional plantar flexion.

This ankle joint allows dynamic management of plantar flexion contractures in weight bearing and non-weight bearing devices. It
also allows progressive management of plantar flexion contractures throughout the therapy rehab process. Accommodating progressive
dorsi-flexion position as patient’s range increases. Once lock is released the joint will function as a free motion ankle joint.

name: Vertex Dynamic Ratchet Lock Ankle Joint - Bushing -Pediatruc
group: Vertex Dynamic Ratchet Lock Ankle Joint Replacement Parts

variations.name: Vertex Dynamic Ratchet Lock Ankle Joint - Bushing -Pediatruc

short: The Vertex Dynamic Ratchet Lock Ankle Joint incorporatesa unique one way pressure activated ratcheting locking mechanism. This mechanism allows the patient to easily don the orthosis whilepositioned in plantar flexion. Once activator strap is fastened theankle joint will lock into any desired dorsi-flexion position, while not allowing the patient to go back into plantar flexion. The joint willallow for more dorsi-flexion, but will not allow additional plantar flexion. This ankle joint allows dynamic management of plantar flexion contractures in weight bearing and non-weight bearing devices. It also allows progressive management of plantar flexion contractures throughout the therapy rehab process. Accommodating progressive dorsi-flexion position as patient’s range increases. Once lock is released the joint will function as a free motion ankle joint.

intro: The Dyna-Lock Dynamic Ankle Joint is a unique design incorporating the patent pending one way pressure activated locking mechanism. This mechanism allows the patient to easily don the orthosis while positioned in plantar flexion. Once activator strap is fastened the ankle joint will lock into any desired dorsi-flexion position, while not allowing the patient to go back into plantar flexion. The joint will allow for more dorsi-flexion, but will not allow additional plantar flexion.

short: The Baseline Cinch Stop is a plantar flexion stop system where the various stop sizes can be easily switched to attain and or adjust sagittal alignment. Simply remove and “cinch” the stop into place without the need for adhesives, screws, or thermoforming. The kit includes the molding blank and the four different Cinch Stop sizes. The Cinch Stop can be placed in the top, bottom, or both posterior channels to attain desired alignment. The Cinch Stop is sold as a kit, or by individual sizes. Individual items can also be ordered to replenish kits. The Cinch Stop is offered in Adult and Pediatric sizing and in Black and White colors. The Baseline Cinch Stop is extremely cost effective, high quality, durable, and Made in America.

The Cinch Stop can be placed in the top, bottom, or both posterior channels to attain desired alignment. The Cinch Stop is sold as a kit, or by individual sizes. Individual items can also be ordered to replenish kits. The Cinch Stop is offered in Adult and Pediatric sizing and in Black and White colors. The Baseline Cinch Stop is extremely cost effective, high quality, durable, and Made in America.

intro: The Certified Extension Assist Kits can be fit/retrofit to virtually any off the shelf Knee Orthoses or Knee Joints, or utilized in Custom Knee Orthoses and KAFO’s. The Extension Assist Kits offer a unique system providing significant extension assist at the knee joint. Kits are offered with the extension assist components only to be utilized with any knee joint, or with Certified’s Polycentric Knee Joints. Tension is adjusted/set by length of the tubing or with optional Extension Assist Ratchet that can be purchased as an accessory to provide easy assist/resist tension adjustment.

sections.title: Features, Benefits, & Options

Provides Significant Extension Assist at Knee Joint
Strength of extension assist can be varied by simply adjusting the length of the tubing, or through utilizing the optional ratchet buckle to adjust tension
Midsection channel allows complete tension relief for sitting, or progression through the therapy/rehab process
Kit Includes all Extension Assist Components as shown

intro: The GO AFO Carbon Strut allows for dynamic motion and energy return, which normalizes gait pattern while reducing energy expenditure. The Strut Kits allow the practitioner to design custom AFO/KAFO systems that provide all of the dynamic function of a traditional carbon device. The GO AFO Strut also provide the ability to design extremely lightweight, strong, and low profile AFO/KAFO designs. The GO Strut kits are offered to address any desired Custom Adult or Pediatric designs. The GO AFO Strut Kits allow easily application to custom foot plate designs.

sections.title: Features, Benefits, & Options
items: Offered as a complete kit with all three strut sizes, or order kits with individual sizing.
All kits Include the GO Strut, attachment plates, fabrication molding blanks, pads, and attachment fasteners.
Struts are offered in 5”, 7” or 9” Lengths with premade holes to align with attachment plates. Custom lengths can be requested.
Six Month Warranty on GO Carbon Strut.

It is offered with a medial or lateral knee compartment utilizing a dial lock strap system for fine tune adjustment and unloading. This low profile and light weight design offers patient comfort, stability, and pain relief. Offered in sizes extra- small through extra large, or custom to measurement, scan, or cast.

intro: The Certified Extension Assist is a unique Knee Orthosis providing significant extension assist at the knee joint in a prefabricated system. Offered in sizes extra small through extra large, or custom to measurement, scan, or cast.

sections.title: Product Highlights
html:
• Provides Significant Extension Assist at Knee Joint
• High quality, low profile polycentric knee joints
• Assist provided by tubing attached medially and laterally
• Tubing extends from proximal thigh cuff through a modified
condyle attachment at knee center to distal cuff
• Strength of extension assist can be varied by simply adjusting the tension on the tubing through the ratchet buckle
• Midscection channel allows complete tension relief for sitting, or progression through the therapy/rehab process
• Removable/Washable Soft Interface Lining
• Prefabricated Sizing XS, S, M, L, XL or
• Custom to Measurement, Scan, or Cast
• Extension Assist Kits can be purchased separately to incorporate into desired KO or KAFO.

sections.title: Indications & Uses
html:
• Quad Weakness
• Stabilizing Flaccid Knee
• M/L Instabilities with Knee Weakness
• Contracture Managment

variations.name: Hi-Five Pediatric SEWHO - Infant

intro: The Hi-Five SEWHO was developed to easily manage positioning of the shoulder joint complex. The Hi-Five orthosis can be easily adjusted in Abduction, Adduction, External/Internal Rotation, as well as Flexion and Extension of the shoulder. The orthosis position is simply adjusted throughout the therapy rehab process. The orthosis is constructed with universal positioning for left or right applications, additional arm sections can be ordered for bilateral positioning, and has removable and washable liners. The Hi-Five can be ordered by size, custom to measurement, or custom to cast or scan.

sections.title: Indications & Uses
items: Post Muscle Release and Muscle Transfer of the Shoulder

intro: The GO FO pre-sized foot orthotic is designed for high activity clients to be utilized for sports, work, and recreation. This low profile and anti-fatigue design is heat moldable offering an enhanced and customized fit for a wide variety of foot conditions. The unique design elements of the GO FO address a wide range of foot issues, while still allowing fit into a variety of footwear. Including athletic shoes, cleats, hiking boots, work boots, dress shoes, hockey skates, etc. The optional heel stabilizer component can be utilized with th GO FO for enhanced stability/balance, heel positioning and supination control. The GO FO’s are proudly made in the USA!

variations.name: KIDFAB Baseline Custom Lone Tone SMO

intro: The Baseline Low Tone SMO addresses orthotic management for pediatrics with hypotonia, flexible pes planus. and ankle instability. The Low Tone SMO utilizes a thin and flexible plastic creating an extremely low profile design. This flexible system compresses soft tissues offering stability, while still allowing for natural movement and child development. The Low Tone SMO may be ordered custom by measurement, custom to scan, or cast.

variations.name: KIDFAB Custom SMO - Standard Molded

short: SMO Standard Molded

intro: The Certified Standard SMO addresses orthotic management for pediatrics with significant forefoot, midfoot, and subtalar instability. The Standard SMO also addresses pediatric patients who present with excessive pronation and/or supination. The SMO is fabricated with a semi rigid thermoplastic providing good stability while still allowing ankle motion for standing, crawling, and/or walking. Line includes the Standard Molded Design, with Flexible Plastic Inner Boot, or Flexible Foam Inner Boot. The Standard SMO may be ordered custom by measurement, custom to scan, or custom to cast

name: KIDFAB Toe-Walking Custom SMO with Molded UCB
group: KIDFAB Toe Walking Custom SMO's & AFO

variations.name: KIDFAB Toe-Walking Custom SMO with Molded UCB

short: w/Molded UCB (Standard)

intro: The Toe Walker Orthosis (T.W.O.) design provides a real orthotic solution to idiopathic toe walking. This orthosis re-establishes the heel to toe gait pattern creating a residual effect allowing the patient to "graduate," into standard footwear. The T.W.O. combines the design of a traditional SMO with carbon reinforced extended posterior element which provides a kinesthetic reminder to promote heel strike. The design also keeps the heel and mid-foot locked in a neutral position helping to prevent toe walking. The T.W.O. is offered in five different styles to address specific patient needs.

short: Skeleton Solid Ankle SMO/AFO

intro: The Skeleton Style SMO/AFO features abbreviated trimlines allowing for a low profile AFO without compromising stability or control. This design has open posterior trim lines with medial & lateral carbon reinforced uprights for rigidity, while incorporating a flexible plastic SMO and flexible plastic Calf Lacer for point of contact control and adjustability. The Skeleton SMO/AFO provides a lightweight and low profile design compared to traditional thermoplastic Solid Ankle SMO/AFO’s. The slim line design also provides enhanced patient comfort, better shoe fit, and more adjustability for pediatric orthotic management.

The Skeleton SMO/AFO provides a lightweight and low profile design compared to traditional thermoplastic Solid Ankle SMO/AFO’s. The slim line design also provides enhanced patient comfort, better shoe fit, and more adjustability for pediatric orthotic management.

intro: The Dynamic Stretch AFO incorporates the Vertex Dynamic Ratchet Locking Ankle Joint allowing for dynamic management of plantar flexion contractures in weight bearing and non-weight bearing devices. The one way pressure activating joint mechanism allows for incremental dorsi-flexion position control throughout the therapy rehab process. AFO can be applied no matter the severity or degree of tone or plantar flexion contracture, and ratchet mechanism locks AFO into the desired dorsi-flexion position. The ankle joint accommodates progressive dorsi-fexion position as patient’s range increases. The joint can be quickly disengaged for ease of donning and doffing, and acts as a free motion system when lock is not engaged. Design and function provides for simple, comfortable, and effective contracture management. AFO allows for free motion ambulation and has foot plate tread for safety.

variations.name: Stabilizer Unweightng Carbon Fiber Solid Ankle AFO

short: Carbon Solid Ankle

intro: The Skywalker Unweighting AFO is a unique custom unweighting Ankle Foot Orthosis using proven design concepts and materials. The supple leather calf corset allows for a moldable self-reconforming orthosis. This design provides for a completely adjustable/total contact hydrostatic lift of the inverted cone shape of the calf, which can achieve 100% unweighting! The addition of rigid carbon fiber and or metal joints provides a strong stable substructure in order to transfer weight to the calf and not through the foot and ankle.

sections.title: Clinical Indications
items: Pre or Post surgical intervention of the mid and hind foot

notes: Stabilizer SMO's are priced as a complete system - no addition codes will applu
short: SMO Standard Molded

intro: The Certified Standard SMO addresses orthotic management for pediatrics with significant forefoot, midfoot, and subtalar instability. The Standard SMO also addresses pediatric patients who present with excessive pronation and/or supination. variations.name: Custom Thermoplastic Standard UCBL

short: * Rigid UCBL Construction: • Molded Polypro Thermoplastic • Crepe Posting

intro: Certified offers two custom UCBL styles. The classic thermoplastic Rigid UCBL and the Soft UCBL. The Rigid UCBL is fabricated with rigid polypropylene plastic and posted to neutral. The Soft UCBL incorporates softer padding materials and a semi-rigid thermoplastic to address patients who require the containment of a UCBL, while offering cushioning and a less rigid option. We accept impression kits, casts, and scans to fabricate custom UCBL's.

sections.title: Clinical Indications
items: Requiring more containment than Foot Orthosis

sections.title: Features & Benefits
items: Any custom modification desired can be accommodated
